author: Totally Not Mark
description:
Super Saiyan God Goku vs Beerus in Dragon Ball Super: Beerus episode 5. This is the most ambitious remaster of the series to date with more new animation than I anticipated. It's wonderful and I can't wait to sit down to break it all down with you today! 

in 2015, Episode 5 became infamous, in 2026 it sets a new benchmark! Congrats Dragon Ball!
